# requires: wire
#
# DREAM.md § Rights: turn May reach off and the application's next connection
# is refused with a reason it can show. Until this scenario the question was
# put at the command line and the runner reached whatever a record named. This
# is the refusal at the point a connection would be opened: the source is fine,
# this machine will not go there, and the job is left for a machine that may —
# or for the same machine once the switch is turned back on.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:plain
refuse 127.0.0.1 not on this machine's list
run A alpha
orphans
allow 127.0.0.1
run A alpha
state A

# expect 3: transfer-failed state=pending [DL-E8]
# expect 3: done=0 err=set [DL-E1]
# expect 4: ok A
# expect 6: ok state=transferred
